prompt: Where do starter workflows surface when a developer clicks "New workflow" from a repository’s Actions tab?
explanation: The New workflow page offers GitHub’s starter set alongside templates your organization publishes, so company-standard pipelines sit next to the defaults. Choosing one copies the YAML into your `.github/workflows/` to edit freely.

options.text: From GitHub’s curated set plus any templates your organization publishes
Only from GitHub’s curated set — organizations cannot add their own
From every workflow file in every public repository you follow
